description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Samwise the Stouthearted trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
